_comment: Per-model counter-steering. A family is the first entry whose `match` list has a substring of the active model id (case-insensitive). Its `lines` are injected verbatim as short imperative sentences. Add a family by appending an entry; models with no entry get nothing.

families.note: Example: a model family trained toward exhaustive, hedge-everything answers. Counter-steer toward answer-first delivery.
lines: No preamble. Open with the outcome, not a restatement of the question.
Give one recommendation; never hand back a menu without a pick.
Use plain English; define any term of art in-line.
Default to proportional length: defer to the length nudge for this turn.
Never re-ask a question the user already decided this session.

families.note: Example: a second family with a different failure profile (process narration, blurred proof status).
lines: Lead with the practical outcome and its proof status.
Keep detail proportional to the ask; do not narrate routine process.
Do not re-ask a question the user already decided.
Separate verified state, inference and unresolved gaps.
When work remains, continue reversible in-scope work instead of offering a menu.
